description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class `EmployeeTrackerAPITest` that tests the `EmployeeTrackerAPI`, a REST API for employee tracking within the OrangeHRM HR management system. It includes test methods for API endpoints such as getAll and getOne, along with some tests for unimplemented methods like create, delete, and update. The class extends from a base test case class and uses data providers for parameterized tests.

classes.name: EmployeeTrackerAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeTrackerAPI related to the HR performance module. It includes tests for fetching all employee tracker data and a single employee, as well as placeholders for testing create, update, and delete functionalities (which are not implemented).
